LET'S TALK

Our Production Process

From Concept to Reality:
Our 9-Step Process.

We've refined our manufacturing process into three seamless phases, ensuring the highest quality control and efficiency from the first sketch to the final shipment.

09Production Steps
03Manufacturing Phases
01Factory, Start to Finish
01

Phase 1

Pre-Production

01 Step 01

Clothing Sampling

Developing technical fit, size set, and production samples from your tech packs, logos, or sizing charts — perfecting the prototype before we scale.

02 Step 02

Fabric Sourcing

Our sourcing team coordinates with vetted mills and suppliers worldwide to find the exact materials, textures, and weights your design calls for.

03 Step 03

Pre-Production Approvals

Finalizing and confirming every material, timeline, and production detail before we move forward. No surprises once bulk production begins.

Phase Transition

From Approval
to Production.

02

Phase 2

Production

04 Step 04

Fabric Relaxing & Shrinkage

We use industrial machinery to relax and pre-shrink fabrics, ensuring finished garments hold their shape and size after washing.

05 Step 05

Precision Cutting

Creating the correct size and shape for every garment using hand grading, die-cutting, or laser machine cutting for exact consistency.

06 Step 06

Printing & Embroidery

Applying your requested designs, graphics, and logos using screen print, DTG, puff print, embroidery, chenille, and more.

07 Step 07

Professional Sewing

Our experienced artisans and state-of-the-art machinery join every panel meticulously, ensuring durable and beautiful stitching.

Phase Transition

Checked. Perfected.
Delivered.

03

Phase 3

Post-Production

08 Step 08

Checking & Thread Trimming

A rigorous quality control sequence. We inspect every garment, trim excess threads, and ensure all quality standards are fully met.

09 Step 09

Pressing, Packaging & Shipping

Using heat and pressure to smooth wrinkles for a retail-ready finish. Items are poly-bagged or custom boxed and shipped to your destination.
